description:
Activate Viridian Joiner by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting Viridian Joiner.
Battlemage's Bracers triggers, causing you to pay {1} to copy Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting Aphetto Alchemist.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and Viridian Joiner.
Repeat.

uses.name: Viridian Joiner
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
